title: Observe European descriptor field four in Steal menu
changes: Document ordinary field-4 reads from descriptor banks 1 through 23 in the retained Steal menu.
validation: Authenticated original Wine source windows and ran one existing 280-frame Wine scene; 60 typed field-4 bytes were read with guarded inputs and frozen sources unchanged.
limitations: Aggregate counts do not identify exact records or PCs; the full scene comparison, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
